correctness.rationale: At each nonhub vertex indegree>=1 forbids the sign transition (-,+), leaving exactly two directed cycle orientations and ell_i-1 outward paths. Global hub indegree requires at least one cycle petal. An outward petal forces ell_i-3 additional selected vertices, a cyclic petal ell_i-2, and the hub plus one cyclic terminal predecessor are forced. The k-cyclic formula and product enumerator follow. Exhaustive independent orientation/subset checks on five bouquets reproduced exact coefficients.

originality.rationale: The full valid-orientation distribution for multicyclic bouquets is not supplied by the inspected orientable-total-domination papers, which determine unicyclic and selected extremal cases. Scalar t=2 upper bound and t=1 cycle case are credited to prior general results.
